messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH — Catalyst (customer) dedicated pool 'catalyst-usw2-pool' experiencing elevated 5xx rate and tail latency >3s. Affected routes: /v1/generate (gpt-3-family). Autoscale not keeping up. Paging on-call.

kyle (oncall): taking. I see spikes in telemetry. pulling logs now.

maria (eng): logged in to pool host, KV cache pressure looks high and one tenant is spiking seq len. suspect noisy-tenant. continuing investigation.

ben (infra): if it's a single tenant we can isolate onto a spare node and restore capacity quickly. prepping node spare-03 in us-west-2.

kyle (oncall): timeline so far: 09:12 UTC first error surge, 09:14 error rate >3%, 09:18 autoscale attempted x2 but queue backlog stayed high. current qlen 420.

alice (cs): flagging customer impact: Catalyst reports 40% request failures from their webapp. they just escalated to their SRE. Need a brief for customer ASAP. I can draft a message once we confirm mitigation.

maria (eng): mitigation plan: 1) isolate noisy tenant (tenant-id: t-98321) to spare-03; 2) temporarily reroute Catalyst to fallback model variant with shorter seq (model: rdw-mini-v1) to reduce latency; 3) enable aggressive prefix cache eviction for 10m. Executing isolation now.

ben (infra): spare-03 warmed, performing tenant migration via orchestration. command:
```
rdwctl migrate-tenant --from pool=catalyst-usw2-pool --to node=spare-03 --tenant t-98321 --grace 30s
```

incident-bot: migration job started (job_id: mj-1787654321-01). ETA ~3m.

kyle (oncall): migration finished, CPU/KV pressure dropped on catalyst pool. errors dropped to ~0.5% and p95 latency down to 420ms. good so far.

maria (eng): toggled fallback route for Catalyst to rdw-mini-v1 for 15 minutes to let caches stabilize. route change:
```
route set catalyst_org --model rdw-mini-v1 --ttl 900s --reason "mitigation fallback"
```

alice (cs): sent initial customer note (internal draft): "We're actively mitigating a noisy tenant causing elevated errors and latency in your dedicated pool. We've isolated the tenant and applied a temporary fallback to a lower-latency model. We expect normal service within the next 15 minutes. We'll follow up with an RCA and credit proposal." Waiting for confirmation before sending.

sre_lead: good mitigation. please capture timelines and the migration job logs for RCA. Also need cost delta estimate for the fallback and spare node for finance/credits discussion.

acct-mgr: noted — please include an estimated impact window and affected request count. I'll calculate provisional credit % for discussion with sales.

sales-ops: FYI — Catalyst is on enterprise contract. Exec wants a short briefing if customer requests >10% credit. Can we assemble a one-pager by EOD with impact, mitigation, and proposed credit band?

maria (eng): collecting logs and metrics. rough numbers: impacted window 09:12–09:21 UTC (~9 min), peak failed requests ~12k, average latency for impacted requests 2.7s -> after mitigation 420ms. attaching log refs: mj-1787654321-01, route-change-1787654350.

kyle (oncall): closing live bridge in 20m but keep monitoring for 2 hours. if we see recurrence, escalate to full pool scaling and tenant throttle policy.

alice (cs): sending revised customer note now with confirmed mitigations and ETA. will schedule a post-incident call with Catalyst CS/SRE for tomorrow 16:00 UTC and offer an exec summary.

sre_lead: assign RCA owner — @maria please lead RCA draft, include root cause (noisy tenant long sequences + cache pressure), mitigations, long-term fixes (tenant-level throttles, autoscale tuning, spare node reservation), and recommended credits proposal. Draft due EOD tomorrow.

acct-mgr: provisional credit recommendation: 5–8% of monthly usage for the impacted service tier, pending exact request counts and business impact. will finalize after metrics confirm.

sales-ops: I'll prepare an exec-facing slide with the mitigation timeline and the credit recommendation once we have final numbers. Thanks team. :handshake:

kyle (oncall): monitoring alert thresholds adjusted to catch similar KV pressure earlier. closing thread for active paging — follow-ups will continue in #post-incident-catalyst (creating doc now).
